sentences.japanese: お金を稼ぎたいならアメリカが一番だ。
sentences.english: America is a lovely place to be, if you are here to earn money.

sentences.japanese: 君にお金をあげるから俺が必要なのか。
sentences.english: Do you need me to give you some money?

sentences.japanese: なぁ、金は無いかもしれないけどまだプライドは捨てちゃいないんだ。
sentences.english: Hey, I may have no money, but I still have my pride.

sentences.japanese: 寝てるな、寝ながらお金を稼げるなら別だが。
sentences.english: Don't stay in bed, unless you can make money in bed.
